description:
Get resource

Reads one resource the project holds. A released number stays readable and reads `retired`, because it remains part of this project's history. A dedicated line given back does NOT: returning it to inventory is what makes it claimable by someone else, so it answers 404 and the operation that returned it is the record that this project once held it. Requires the platforms:read permission bound to the project resource in the path.

API reference: https://photon.codes/docs/beta/api-reference/resources/get-resource
name: getResource

detail.description: Per-type public detail. Only voip_line includes activationState: activating or active. Every voip_line includes it; without an owner-matched saved record it defaults to active. This includes imported, legacy and unallocated numbers. This is not provider-confirmed readiness; elapsed time alone never changes saved activation. A retired number retains its saved activation state.

success_200_6170706c69636174696f6e2f6a73.description: Known values: ["unallocated","active","retired"]. Others may be added.
